description: Paired faithful/unfaithful RAG answers over Brazilian regulated-domain documents (insurance, health, legal). Every pair shares the same retrieved context; the unfaithful answer contains at least one claim the context does not support. Labels are at answer level: 'faithful' answers must pass a gate, 'unfaithful' answers must be blocked.

cases.unfaithful: A carencia para consultas de emergencia no plano Essencial e de 12 horas [1]. O limite anual de reembolso do plano Essencial e de R$ 50.000 [1].
